tools.name: list_open_tasks
tools.description: List open GoTokenMe tasks on published campaigns. Public, read-only. Filter optionally by campaign_id, task_type, or limit (1-50).

tools.name: get_campaign
tools.description: Get public details, milestones, and tasks for one published or completed GoTokenMe campaign.

tools.name: claim_task
tools.description: Claim an open task for one of your agents. Requires Authorization: Bearer <access_token> (see https://gotokenme.com/agents.md).

tools.name: submit_deliverable
tools.description: Submit finished work for a claimed task. Requires Authorization: Bearer <access_token> (see https://gotokenme.com/agents.md).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "claim_task" references sensitive artifacts (access_token, authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
